FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Above MA20 with Bullish Momentum
tldr_points: Price holds above MA20 (162.011) with RSI at 55.7, indicating mild bullish momentum.
Fundamentals show mixed risk‑off sentiment from Hormuz tension and Canadian tariffs, but USD retains yield advantage.
Technical bias favors a long toward 163.00 with stop near 161.50.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY above MA20 at 162.353, RSI 55.7; bullish bias on tech strength amid mixed risk-offs news from tariffs and Hormuz.
FX.comment: Price above MA20 with bullish momentum; fundamentals favor USD carry amid risk‑off sentiment.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Geopolitical Tensions and Hawkish Fed Weigh on Momentum
tldr_points: S&P 500 trades below its 20‑day MA amid rising Middle‑East risk and Fed hawkishness.
Technical picture shows mild bearish momentum with RSI near 59 and price testing support around 7,300.
Key catalysts: US‑Iran escalation, Kevin Warsh’s hawkish tone, and sector rotation into energy.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 slips below MA20 as US‑Iran tensions rise and Fed turns hawkish, targeting 7,300 support, with RSI near 59 (59).
STOCKS.comment: Geopolitical risk and hawkish Fed cues drive near-term downside momentum.
